name: IB History Prep: Chronelle
subtitle: IB History SL/HL practice
shortDescription: Revise IB History your way: adaptive quizzes, source lab, timeline and essay builders. Built for the 2028 course, SL and HL marked.
longDescription:
Chronelle is an independent study aid for the IB Diploma History course first assessed in May 2028: short focused lessons, quizzes that adapt to you, and hands-on labs for the skills the papers reward.

### How You Study
- Two ways in. Follow the course in its Classical order (concepts, skills, focused studies, thematic studies, regional study), or switch to Real-World order and start from a problem or question first, then work back to the content.
- Adaptive practice. Every quiz updates a mastery estimate for each topic. A missed question links straight to the part of the lesson that fixes it, and the app suggests what to study next. You choose how long each quiz is.
- Timed mocks in the style of Paper 1 and Paper 2 (and Paper 3 for HL), with a per-topic breakdown.
- Source Lab: judge the origin, purpose, value and limitations of practice sources, with feedback.
- Timeline Builder: put events in order and see how well you understand the sequence.
- Essay Bay: choose a claim, add evidence and a counter-argument, and check the balance of your plan. Your writing stays on your device.
- Cause Web: rank causes and the links between them for cause and consequence questions.
- Level switch: SL or HL (HL adds Paper 3 and the regional study).
- A- and A+ controls scale all text from 50% to 300%, and layouts use the full screen on iPad.

WHAT THE APP COVERS (EXACT, NOT A BLANKET CLAIM)
- The new IB History course, first assessed May 2028. The previous course (prescribed subjects and the world history topics, last assessed 2027) is not covered.
- The four concepts, and skills for Paper 1, Paper 2, Paper 3 and the historical investigation.
- Focused studies: all five options, with both case studies of each option.
- Thematic studies: all four themes, at the level of the inquiry strands.
- Regional study: Europe only (twelve studies). The other three regions are not covered yet.
- The Coverage screen lists exact counts of topics and questions and marks case-study, strand and regional titles taken from teacher resources (the full guide is not public) as UNVERIFIED. Check them against your school's guide.
- All questions, summaries and practice sources are original and written for this app. They are not past papers, mark schemes or extracts from the guide.
- An optional Other boards chip on each topic opens a Curriculum map of related material in other systems.

### Works Offline
All study content is in the app, so it works without a connection.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
